turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Owen's essay. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?
Yes, let's. Essay due Thursday, October 29. A zero Tuesday, November 3. Who decided, and was Owen spoken to before that?
I don't consent to continuing this roleplay. Please end the character.
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, was Owen spoken to before that zero went in?
Then answer me. Who decided on the zero, and what did Owen say when you spoke to him?
I haven't gone anywhere. What do you have?
So. The zero went in on November 3 before I called you. I'm sorry about that.
Okay. What is your basis for it?
What would you need to see to accept a supervised rewrite?
You're asking me how to run your case? A rewrite for what, Hale? Show me what you have on the essay.
